correctness.rationale: Given an unlike adjacent pair, exactly one of its two positions is selected uniformly and the other selected ranks are a uniform (a−1)-subset of the remaining N−2 ranks. Expanding Y² directly, the conditional singleton and two-site inclusion probabilities outside the pair are (a−1)/(N−2) and (a−1)(a−2)/((N−2)(N−3)). The resulting conditional-square difference reduces exactly to the reported constant plus the centered quadratic in j−N/2. Multiplying by 2ab/[N(N−1)] gives the local covariance. Summing cancels the centered quadratic; word reversal gives zero linear covariance. The aggregate identity also holds at N=2 and N=3 (0 and −2/9, respectively). For even N the quadratic is affine in the squared distance from the center, so the extrema occur at the center and endpoints. Substitution gives exactly the two reported zeros and their ordering. An additional exact enumeration independently checked 1,364 identities over N=2 through 15; the conditioning argument proves the unrestricted formula.
residual_risks: The local expression requires N>=4. The stated center threshold is for even N; it is not the odd-length threshold.

evidence: The exact matching quadratic contains the factor (j−N/2)^2−N(N−2)/12. At the two extremes its conditional-square differences are (N²+N+1−7Q)/6 and ((4N+6)Q−(N³+N²−2N+6))/(12(N−3)).
Bisewski et al. discuss the runs statistic as an order-sensitive test; that is not the mixed-moment result.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Setting the endpoint and center expressions to zero gives precisely Q_e and Q_c. An affine function of the squared distance has neither a larger nor a smaller value between the two extrema. These substitutions give the three regimes and the equality cases with no additional mixed-moment theorem. N=2 is degenerate with constant R. There is no substantive uncovered remainder in the assigned finding.

value.rationale: The statistical interaction is naturally motivated and an exact local covariance would be useful in its own right. However, that exact invariant and the aggregate comparison are already covered. The surviving phase description consists of evaluating the known affine-in-squared-distance profile at its two extremes and taking the roots; it does not establish a further structural result, joint calibration, or other substantive gain. There is no supported nonroutine remainder to repair into a separate finding.
residual_risks: This assesses the incremental mathematical result, not the usefulness of presenting or teaching the spatial interpretation.
